summary: Tested two new features for Skægagamer: (A) automatic age-category computation from dragon birthday (removed manual picker), and (B) 'Kopier til dage' bulk-copy for schedule slots. Backend: rewrote /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py (17 tests) - ALL PASSED after cleaning up leftover TEST_ dragon pollution from a prior session that was blocking MAX_DRAGONS=5. Verified compute_age_category logic, age_category is ignored on create/update payloads and freshly computed on read/list/update, dragon aging out of a bracket correctly removes old-bracket tasks from daily-overview, and POST /api/schedule-slots/bulk-copy creates correct cartesian product + upserts (overwrites) existing day/age slots without duplication. Frontend (mobile viewport 375x667, Playwright): dragon-form has NO manual Alderskategori picker, shows read-only computed badge correctly for both new (defaults to today -> '2-4 måneder') and existing dragons (Sif, birthday 13mo ago -> '12+ måneder' shown correctly on edit + list after save). CopyToDaysSheet renders correctly with 'Nuværende' tag + disabled checkbox for current day/age; manually checking 2 extra days + 1 extra age correctly updated subtitle to '3 dage × 2 perioder = 6 opgaver', saved successfully with matching toast, and verified the same Fodring/Bladgrønt task appeared in all 6 day/age combinations via UI. FOUND A REAL BUG: the 'Vælg alle' (select-all) quick-select buttons for both Ugedage and Alderskategorier never toggle to 'Fjern alle'/deselect - clicking it repeatedly always re-selects all, because the toggle comparison (prev.length === DAYS_OF_WEEK.length / AGE_CATEGORIES.length) compares against the FULL list length (7/4), while selectedDays/selectedAges arrays can only ever reach length 6/3 since the current day/age is deliberately excluded from that array (handled separately as always-checked-disabled). This also means the button label is permanently stuck showing 'Vælg alle', never 'Fjern alle'.

minor.issue: Found 4 leftover TEST_ dragons from a prior testing session that were never cleaned up, which had filled the DB to the MAX_DRAGONS=5 limit and blocked new dragon creation. Deleted them before running tests. Recommend future test runs always clean up TEST_-prefixed seed data at teardown.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Vælg alle' select-all button for Ugedage and Alderskategorier in the copy-to-days sheet never toggles back to deselect/'Fjern alle'. Root cause: selectedDays/selectedAges state arrays exclude the current day/age (by design, since that one is always-checked+disabled), so their max length is DAYS_OF_WEEK.length-1 (6) / AGE_CATEGORIES.length-1 (3). But the toggle comparison checks `prev.length === DAYS_OF_WEEK.length` (7) / `=== AGE_CATEGORIES.length` (4), which is never true. Result: clicking 'Vælg alle' always (re)selects all remaining days/ages and the button text never switches to 'Fjern alle', so users cannot bulk-deselect.

react_native_issues.issue: Console logs 'DateTimePicker is not supported on: web' when opening the Fødselsdag picker - this library has no web implementation, so on the web preview the birthday date CANNOT be changed via UI interaction (tapping the field opens nothing visible/functional). This blocked interactive verification of the 'pick birthday -> live badge update' requirement via Playwright; verification for that specific scenario was instead done by editing an existing dragon (Sif) whose birthday was already >12mo old, confirming the computed badge showed '12+ måneder' correctly on load. This is likely a pre-existing web-platform limitation unrelated to this session's changes, but worth flagging since it affects testability/usability of the exact new UX being requested (live-updating computed badge as user picks a date) on web.

action_items: Fix 'Vælg alle' toggle bug in schedule-slot-form.tsx: selectAllDays/selectAllAges comparisons should account for the excluded current day/age (e.g. compare selectedDays.length === DAYS_OF_WEEK.length - 1, or compute allDaysSelected/allAgesSelected the same way in both schedule-slot-form.tsx and CopyToDaysSheet.tsx using a shared derived boolean).

Consider a web-compatible birthday date input fallback (e.g. Platform.OS==='web' branch rendering a native <input type=date> or a custom calendar modal) so the birthday can actually be edited when testing/using via the web preview - not strictly required for mobile but affects web testability.

No other issues found - automatic age-category computation (backend compute_age_category, ignoring client-sent age_category, live recompute on list/get/update, and daily-overview age-bracket matching) all verified working correctly. Bulk-copy cartesian product creation and upsert/overwrite semantics verified working correctly with no duplication.
critical_code_review_comments: models.py compute_age_category and its usage across dragons.py/overview.py/schedule_slots.py is clean and consistent - single source of truth, no duplication.
bulk-copy endpoint correctly upserts per (age,day) using existing time_id+category match, avoiding duplicate slots - verified via direct backend test and UI regression.

Minor code smell: selectAllDays/selectAllAges duplicate the 'exclude current' filtering logic already present in toggleCopyDay/toggleCopyAge, and the allDaysSelected/allAgesSelected boolean is independently (and incorrectly) recomputed in CopyToDaysSheet.tsx - recommend centralizing this logic to avoid the length-mismatch bug found in this session.
dragon-form.tsx correctly removed all age_category form state/picker and replaced with a live useMemo-computed read-only badge - clean implementation.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% - core flows work, 1 select-all bug found in copy sheet

seed_data_creation: None left behind - all TEST_ dragons and TEST_ schedule slots created during this session were deleted after verification. Pre-existing seed data (dragon 'Sif', times, task-items) untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend feature A+B fully verified via updated test_backend.py (17/17 passing). Frontend feature A verified working (no manual picker, correct computed badges on create/edit/list). Frontend feature B core flow verified working (copy sheet checkboxes, subtitle count, save creates correct cartesian product, upsert overwrite confirmed via backend test) EXCEPT the 'Vælg alle' select-all quick-button which has a real toggle-comparison bug (never deselects). After main agent fixes that, retest by: open copy sheet, tap 'Vælg alle' for Ugedage -> should select all 6 non-current days AND button label should switch to 'Fjern alle' -> tap again -> should deselect all and switch back to 'Vælg alle'. Repeat for Alderskategorier.
rca_of_issue: selectAllDays()/selectAllAges() in schedule-slot-form.tsx use `prev.length === DAYS_OF_WEEK.length` (7) / `=== AGE_CATEGORIES.length` (4) to decide whether to clear or fully populate selectedDays/selectedAges. However these state arrays never include the current day/age (toggleCopyDay/toggleCopyAge return early for the current value, and selectAllDays/selectAllAges themselves .filter() out the current value when populating). So the array can reach at most length 6/3, never 7/4 - the 'already fully selected -> clear' branch is dead code. Same incorrect full-length check is duplicated in CopyToDaysSheet.tsx's `allDaysSelected`/`allAgesSelected` used for the button label. Fix: compare against `DAYS_OF_WEEK.length - 1` / `AGE_CATEGORIES.length - 1` (or filter the comparison list to exclude current in both places).
